name: Line Manager Plus
summary: Line info on hover, Shift-click a line to manage it, undo/redo, line actions and rate matching.
description: See any line's vehicles and statistics by hovering it in the line list, on the map or in Send to Line (with a before/after estimate), Shift-click a line on the map to open it in the line manager, undo and redo stop edits, duplicate or reverse a line, and size a line's fleet to its supply. Replaces Line Editor Undo. GUI only: the savegame keeps just its interface data.

ru.name: Управление маршрутами Plus
ru.summary: Сведения о маршруте при наведении, Shift+щелчок открывает маршрут, отмена/повтор, действия, оборот.

de.name: Linien-Manager Plus
de.summary: Linieninfo beim Überfahren, Shift+Klick öffnet die Linie, Rückgängig/Erneut, Linienaktionen, Rate.

fr.name: Gestionnaire de lignes Plus
fr.summary: Infos de ligne au survol, Maj+clic ouvre la ligne, annuler/rétablir, actions de ligne, taux.

es.name: Gestor de líneas Plus
es.summary: Info de línea al pasar el ratón, Mayús+clic abre la línea, deshacer/rehacer, acciones, ajustar tasa.

it.name: Gestore linea Plus
it.summary: Info linea al passaggio del mouse, Maiusc+clic apre la linea, annulla/ripeti, azioni linea, indice.

nl.name: Lijnbeheer Plus
nl.summary: Lijninfo bij aanwijzen, Shift+klik opent de lijn, ongedaan maken/opnieuw, lijnacties, aantal.

pl.name: Zarządca linii Plus
pl.summary: Informacje o linii po najechaniu, Shift+klik otwiera linię, cofnij/ponów, akcje linii, wydolność.

pt_BR.name: Administrador da Linha Plus
pt_BR.summary: Info da linha ao passar o mouse, Shift+clique abre a linha, desfazer/refazer, ações, ajuste de taxa.

ja.name: 路線マネージャー Plus
ja.summary: ホバーで路線情報、Shift+クリックで路線を開く、元に戻す／やり直し、路線アクション、割合の調整。

ko.name: 노선 관리자 Plus
ko.summary: 마우스를 올리면 노선 정보, Shift+클릭으로 노선 열기, 실행 취소/다시 실행, 노선 작업, 비율 맞추기.

zh_CN.name: 线路管理器 Plus
zh_CN.summary: 悬停显示线路信息、Shift+单击打开线路、撤销/重做、线路操作、比率匹配。

zh_TW.name: 路線調度視窗 Plus
zh_TW.summary: 懸停顯示路線資訊、Shift+點擊開啟路線、復原/重做、路線操作、比率匹配。
